==Quotes==
;Shing Jea Island
:''"If you're  thinking about making the trek to [[Port Kaimu]] think again, the [[Crimson Skull]] run things up there these days."''
:''"I've heard the [[Naga]] have established a stronghold in [[Raiyan Cave]]."''
:''"Life is simple here on Shing Jea Island."''
:''"My family has lived on Shing Jea Island for generations."''
:''"One night each year we celebrate the cherry trees coming into bloom by dancing and feasting until dawn."''
:''"Rumor has it Naga can swallow a man whole!"''
:''"The Crimson Skull have been a lot more active lately."''
:''"The Crimson Skull must pay for their crimes!"''
:''"Times like these make me wish the great heroes of [[Cantha]] like [[Kintah]] were still alive."''
:''"They say every spring the kappa return to [[Onghsang Island]]."''
:''"They say [[kappa]] are especially fond of cucumbers."''
:''"They say [[Qi Falls]] have become haunted by some sort of [[Ang the Ephemeral|spirit]]."''
:''"Where you find kappa you'll find Naga. It's only natural."''
:''"Who knows, maybe someday you will become headmaster of the monastery."''
:''"You look like a student from [[Shing Jea Monastery|the Monastery]]."''

;Kaineng City:
:''"Cantha will make it through any difficulty so long as the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor]] is alive."''
:''"Fruit can be hard to come by these days now that the  plague has slowed trade coming from [[Kryta]]."''
:''"The docks are so empty these days. People are afraid to come to Cantha."''
:''"The emperor cares greatly for all of us who have suffered beacause of [[Afflicted|the plague]]."''
:''"The guards try to keep order but there are fewer of them each day."''
:''"The local guilds are taking over the streets. Most have bought off the [[Celestial Ministry|Ministry]] and do as they please."''
:''"The [[Luxon]]'' {{sic}} ''and [[Kurzick]]s have been quarreling for so long, I think they've probably forgotten why they started fighting to begin with."''
:''"The Ministry of fire'' {{sic}} ''never seems incapable of understanding the plight of the common people."''
:''"The [[Obsidian Flame (guild)|Obsidian Flame]] help keep the rogue [[NPC guilds|guilds]] in check."''
:''"Those [[Am Fah]] thugs are frightening!"''

;Winds of Change:
:''"The people of Cantha embrace us, for they know ours is the side of righteousness."''
:''"This is our home, and you're not going to take it from us!"''
:''"We fight for Cantha! We fight for ourselves!"''
:''"We'll show you what we're capable of!"''
:''"We've had enough of this!"''
:''"You can't keep us down any longer!"''

==Notes==
*They are some of the few [[NPC]]s that fight without wielding a weapon, except for the ones that fight during [[The Gangs of Kaineng]].
*The peasants on Shing Jea have the same dialogue as [[Canthan Guard]]s on Shing Jea and [[Canthan Child|Canthan Children]].
